description: Elections Commission - V. Arulghanam of the Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the United National Freedom Front
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for local authorities, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
